identificationModule.briefTitle: Fruquintinib in the Treatment of Soft Tissue Sarcoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: Single Center, Open, Single Arm Phase II Clinical Study of Fruquintinib in the Treatment of Soft Tissue Sarcoma

descriptionModule.briefSummary: To evaluate the efficacy of Fruquintinib in patients with chemotherapy insensitive or chemotherapy resistant soft tissue sarcoma
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This trial is an open, single arm, single center, prospective phase II clinical study. Objective:To observe the efficacy and safety of Fruquintinib in the first-line treatment of desmoplastic small round cell tumor, epithelioid hemangioendothelioma, solitary fibroma or second-line and posterior line treatment of angiosarcoma.

armGroups.label: Fruquintinib in soft tissue sarcoma
armGroups.description: Fruquintinib : 5mg, once a day (QD), oral on an empty stomach or after a meal, taken with 100 \~ 200ml drinking water for 3 weeks and stopped for 1 week.

interventions.name: Fruquintinib
interventions.description: To observe the efficacy and safety of Fruquintinib in the first-line treatment of desmoplastic small round cell tumor, epithelioid hemangioendothelioma, solitary fibroma or second-line and posterior line treatment of angiosarcoma.
